g.text: Every shift connected. Nothing left behind. ShiftRelay turns handover blind spots into
verifiable operational continuity with original record preservation and mutual sign-offs.
Morning Shift → Evening Shift Custody Handover
Supervisor: Priya Nair • Outgoing Lead | Target: Alex Kumar • Incoming Lead
Assigned to Evening Shift • Original Record ID Maintained
Severity: Level 2 Major • Requires Mandatory Closure Notes
Shift handovers typically rely on fragmented logs, leading to lost context and duplicate record creation.
✕ Disconnected paper notebooks, chat messages and verbal check-ins.
✕ Tasks recreated anew on next shift, breaking historical ID traceability.
✕ No mutual agreement or recorded incoming sign-off.
✕ Repeat rollover items slip through unnoticed without alert thresholds.
✓ Single Page Application with continuous state persistence.
✓ Original record IDs preserved across multiple successive shifts.
✓ Mandatory mutual acknowledgement before shift custody transition.
✓ Automated carry-forward counters flag items rolled 2+ times.
✓ Conflict detection protects concurrent state edits during transition.
How the Shift Baton Passes Seamlessly
Five verifiable stages from outgoing shift capture to incoming custody acceptance.
Outgoing shift tracks tasks and incidents live. Items link directly to active shift.
System automatically aggregates all open items into a structured handover draft.
Outgoing & incoming leads inspect payload, check safety alerts, and note priorities.
Incoming lead formally acknowledges custody, recording mutual sign-off timestamp.
Continuity Engine rolls uncompleted items into the new shift, preserving original IDs.
Architected for Zero Operational Blind Spots
Core algorithmic guarantees enforcing record provenance, mutual agreement, and concurrency safety.
Records (e.g. TK-8241) keep their original identity indefinitely. Carry-forward increments provenance metadata without re-keying or creating duplicate records.
If a task is reassigned during an active handover review, the Continuity Engine detects the concurrency collision and preserves newer state with an audit trail.
Handovers require explicit mutual sign-off. Items cannot jump to 'Carried Forward' through ad-hoc manual state manipulation—custody transfer is formal.
Everything required to operate high-reliability facilities without framework bloat.
Live metrics on carried tasks, repeated rollover risks, shift timelines, and active custody indicators.
Schedule rosters, assign supervisors, verify time boundaries, and prevent overlapping shift misconfigurations.
Automated item aggregation, safety checklists, mutual sign-off workflows, and conflict collision notices.
Priority sorting, due-date monitors, department taxonomies, and immutable audit logs per item.
Severity-tiered incident tracking with mandatory resolution notes upon closure and automatic handover rollover.
Comprehensive temporal audit log of all system state changes, status transitions, and handover sign-offs.
